F3.1.criterion: Average daily cross-sectional R squared above 20%. Below 15% means descriptor construction or weighting is wrong, not that the market is unusual.
F3.1.threshold: mean cross-sectional R squared > 0.20, fail band below 0.15
F3.1.note: The three diagnostics standing instruction B names are stored here whether or not the average clears 20 percent, so a low number can be attributed without a rebuild.

F3.2.criterion: FMP check: X' w_FMP(k) equals the unit vector e_k within 1e-8 for every factor k.
F3.2.note: The criterion tests the factor-mimicking portfolios of the estimated design, the rows of (X'WX)^-1 X'W, where the reference sector is dropped so the market column and the sector block are not collinear. The identified weight set reproduces all eleven reported sector returns and is stored beside it.

F3.3.criterion: Identification: cap-weighted sector factor returns sum to zero within 1e-10 on every day.
F3.3.threshold: abs cap-weighted sector sum < 1e-10 on every day
F3.3.note: Measured on the identified factor returns, every day.

F3.4.criterion: Agreement with the time-series world: XS-v1 momentum factor return vs FF MOM daily correlation above 0.6; market factor vs Mkt-RF above 0.9.
F3.4.note: The market comparison is against Mkt-RF plus RF, the FF total return, on the overlap through 2026-07-31. XS-v1 regresses the total return r because the risk-free series ends there.

F3.5.criterion: Decomposition adds up: factor variance plus idio variance equals w' Sigma w to machine precision; contributions sum to sigma_p.
F3.5.note: Both seed books, every month end the model runs.

F3.6.criterion: Bias statistic for both seed portfolios, monthly 2015 to 2026, between 0.8 and 1.25.
F3.6.threshold: mean monthly bias in [0.8, 1.25] for both books
F3.6.note: The monthly statistic is the book's realized 21-day forward volatility over the model's predicted volatility, estimated point in time at each month end. The criterion is read as the average of the monthly statistics, the reading E2 used for F2.4, and the monthly distribution is stored beside it.

F3.7.criterion: The Fama-MacBeth premia table is produced with Newey-West t-stats for every factor and subperiod, whatever the verdict; a premium with |t| below 2 is reported as unpriced, not dropped.
F3.7.threshold: table complete for every factor and subperiod
F3.7.note: Complete means every factor appears in every subperiod with a Newey-West t statistic, whatever the verdict. Unpriced premia are labelled and kept.

F3.8.criterion: Realized residual covariance is computed for both seed portfolios and the factor share is reported both ways, with the diagonal D and with the realized residual covariance. The criterion passes when both numbers are stored, whatever they show.
F3.8.threshold: both factor shares stored for both books
F3.8.note: The realized residual covariance is estimated on trailing 252-day windows of specific returns, so nothing after the window end enters. The difference against the diagonal D is the measurement the E2 open item asked for.

F3.9.criterion: The XS-v1 exposure time series for the momentum book is stored and reconciled to the E2 measurements in writing.
F3.9.note: The series is x = X'w at each rebalance, so the momentum book is priced from descriptor exposures recomputed when it is held rather than from full-sample betas. The reconciliation against every E2 measurement is written in docs/research/E3_factor_model_note.md.
